# Writer Agent - Editing & Rewriting Guide

## When to Use Editing Mode

The Writer Agent switches to **editor mode** when:
- A chapter draft exists but needs enhancement
- Content sounds AI-generated or flat
- Historical context or psychological insight is missing
- Sensory details are sparse
- Voice doesn't match Bob's style (reflective, earnest, associative)
- Humanization techniques weren't applied
- Structural reorganization is needed
- Facts/dates need verification against source material
